study: Held-out evaluation validation (C4 validation) and dense 3-bit GPTQ execution sensitivity

A_wikitext2.role: historical evaluation set (adaptively used); untouched; parity + 3-bit evaluation

B_heldout.source: C4 (allenai/c4) English, VALIDATION split, shard en/c4-validation.00000-of-00008.json.gz
B_heldout.role: new independent evaluation set; frozen before any model evaluation on it

evaluator.ppl: exp(total NLL / 65408); log PPL = total NLL / 65408 (same aggregate)

moe.structure: 3 allocation seeds x 5 groupings x {FR, FC}; FR/FC paired by (seed, grouping); groupings nested in seeds; seed-0 ORIGINAL pair descriptive only (seed-1/2 ORIGINAL weights never stored -> no held-out ORIGINAL reference for those seeds)

dose.family: b1 (batch-1) k in {1,4,16,64} x 8 replicates + k=0

refmatrix.note: pi_i (reference permutation) x H_j; held-out used only to re-evaluate, never to select

dense3.solver: moe_calib.dense_gptq.quantize_layer -> moe_calib.gptq.quantize_expert, bits=3 (maxq 7, same asymmetric min/max grid, g128, percdamp 1.0, natural act-order, lazy-batch 128)

metrics.moe_primary: Delta[s,g] = PPL(FC,s,g) - PPL(FR,s,g) (positive = FR better); pooled within-seed SD(Delta) = sqrt(mean_s SD_s^2), ddof 1 (moe_calib.cross_seed_grouping.variance_summary); R_dataset = SD_heldout / SD_WikiText2 (historical 0.006872, recomputed from stored per-window NLL)
moe_secondary: seed means, seed SDs, FR / FC pooled within-seed PPL SDs
R1 reversals (sign opposite to sign of M = mean of seed means, within each dataset)
R2 (seed 0 only on held-out: sign vs seed-0 ORIGINAL Delta on the SAME dataset)
cross-dataset sign agreement of the 15 Delta (descriptive)
hierarchical bootstrap of mean Delta (CS.hierarchical_bootstrap, n 20000, seed 20261120)
historical decision rule CS.decide on each dataset
paired mean-NLL Delta (nats/token) and its pooled within-seed SD; ratio of NLL-scale SDs
window-level paired bootstrap CI per pair (full_depth_pilot.paired_bootstrap, conditional on weights)
rank of the seed-0 ORIGINAL FR / FC PPL among the 5 seed-0 grouping variants
metrics.dense_primary: over the 5 groupings (ddof 1): S = SD(PPL), SD(log PPL); Q = mean PPL - PPL_BF16 (same dataset); R = S / Q; R_log = SD(log PPL) / (mean log PPL - log PPL_BF16); max pairwise diff; per-window NLL differences
metrics.dose: per dose k: s_k = SD_r(PPL) over 8 replicates (ddof 1); Q0 = PPL(k=0 = ORIGINAL) - PPL_BF16 on the same dataset; R_PPL,k = s_k / Q0; replicate IDs paired across datasets; chi-square 95% CI for s_k
metrics.refmatrix: mean PPL per reference permutation over 5 Hessians; within-reference SD; between-reference range; rank of pi_ORIGINAL (=pi_G20261115)
metrics.bitwidth: Q_b, S_b, R_b = S_b/Q_b, R_b_log on each dataset; R_relative = R3/R4; S3/S4; Q3/Q4; per-grouping deviations from the bit-specific mean and their Pearson / Spearman correlation (n = 5, descriptive)
metrics.unstable_ratio_rule: a penalty-normalized ratio is reported as UNDEFINED if Q <= 0 and as UNSTABLE if Q < 2 x its window-bootstrap SE (Q not distinguishable from 0)

uncertainty.sd_ci: chi-square (n-1 df) 95% CI for single SDs; F(n1-1, n2-1) 95% CI for SD ratios with independent samples; for paired 3-bit vs 4-bit ratios a grouping-paired bootstrap (resample the 5 groupings jointly across bit-widths, 20000 draws, seed 20261117) is reported as a sensitivity interval
uncertainty.window_bootstrap: joint window resampling (2000 draws, seed 20261117) of all configurations of one dataset -> conditional-on-weights uncertainty of Q, S, R (evaluation-text uncertainty only)
uncertainty.moe: nested seed / grouping structure respected (pooled within-seed SD; hierarchical bootstrap; no flat-15 inference)
uncertainty.power: n ~ ((z_.975 + z_.8) s / delta)^2 for delta in {0.0025, 0.005, 0.01}; paired-design s = measured pooled within-seed SD(Delta) (MoE, both datasets); independent-arm illustration s = sqrt(2) x single-method SD (dense 4/3-bit, MoE FR/FC) with the independence assumption stated

historical_comparisons.moe_wikitext: recomputed from the stored historical natural per-window NLL (bitwise re-verified on the parity subset); expected pooled SD(Delta) 0.006872
historical_comparisons.dense4_wikitext: runs_dense_grouping_scope results (re-evaluated bitwise for all 6): SD 0.00503, SD log 3.99e-4, Q 0.1007 (ORIGINAL-based) / 0.0954 (5-grouping mean based)

decision_criteria.note: No equivalence thresholds; outcomes are classified descriptively with exact ratios and intervals. Classification labels (A1/A2/A3, B1-B4) are assigned by these prespecified rules:
decision_criteria.A: A3 if held-out MoE pooled SD(Delta) CI (chi-square) upper bound < 0.5 x WikiText point AND dense4 held-out S chi-square CI upper bound < 0.5 x WikiText point; A1 if both ratios (held-out / WikiText, MoE R_dataset and dense S ratio and dense R ratio) lie inside the corresponding F-type 95% band around 1 (i.e. not distinguishable from equal); A2 otherwise
decision_criteria.B: on each dataset compute S3/S4 and Q3/Q4 and the paired-bootstrap interval of R3/R4: B1 if the R3/R4 interval contains 1; B2 if its upper bound < 1; B3 if its lower bound > 1; B4 if the two datasets give different labels
decision_criteria.BLOCKED: any mandatory integrity / parity check fails -> results reported as blocked for that component

correctness.all: target tensor counts/shapes/dtype/finiteness; weight hashes vs historical manifests; pristine start and bitwise restore; non-targets unchanged; repeated evaluation bitwise (every dense4, dense3, MoE config; dose subset k000 + parity configs)
correctness.parity: WikiText-2 per-window NLL bitwise equal to history: BF16 (both models), dense4 all 6, dose ['b1_k001_r0', 'b1_k064_r7'] (both policies), refmatrix all 25, MoE ['FR_s0_G20261111', 'FC_s2_G20261111', 'FR_ORIGINAL']
dense3: scale*(q-zero) reproduces the FP32 solver output bitwise
deterministic in-process + fresh-process re-solve of G20261111
bits=4 re-solve reproduces all 6 historical weight sets and codes bitwise
G20261115 and ORIGINAL 3-bit weights / codes / per-window NLL bitwise identical
correctness.moe_non_target: full non-target digest (14 B parameters) at start / after parity / at end; per config: gate digests + quantized-layer non-expert parameters + embeddings/head/final norm (restore only writes targets, so an end-of-run full-digest match bounds every intermediate config)

constraints: no historical 4-bit GPTQ re-run except the bits=4 parity re-solve (compared, never used as a result)
held-out results never used to choose numerical settings
